_note: Page title 'USCIS | Evidence - Inspection and Admission'. This is the I-94 / admission-stamp slot (the I-765 called its equivalent 'form-i-94-passport'). Longest body of the evidence set (~4090 chars) - it lists the categories exempt from this evidence (registry, asylees, VAWA, SIJ, T/U, diplomatic births, 245(i)). Accept: jpeg/jpg/tif/tiff/png/pdf.
